bagLimit: 2 antlered deer per license year (July 1 to June 30), all methods and seasons combined; no limit on antlerless deer with an antlerless tag
sourceTitle: Deer Seasons, Delaware Hunting Guide on eRegulations (DNREC; last updated June 25, 2026)
sourceQuote: Archery Statewide Sept. 1–Jan. 31 | Crossbow Statewide Sept. 1–Jan. 31 | Muzzleloader Statewide Oct. 9–18 Jan. 25–Jan. 31 | General Firearm Statewide Nov. 13–22 Jan. 16–24 | Special Antlerless* Statewide Oct. 2–4, 23–25 and 30–31 Dec. 12–20 | Season closed in Wildlife Management Zones 1A and 1B Jan. 2–10 | Youth and Non-amb ulatory Hunt Statewide Sept. 26 and 27 and Nov. 7–8 | Only 2 antlered deer may be taken during any license year (July 1 – June 30) by all methods and seasons combined. There is no limit on antlerless deer provided a hunter has an antlerless deer tag in their possession before harvesting additional antlerless deer.
notes: The eRegulations pages print month and day only and no season heading; years assigned for 2026-27 (Jul-Dec = 2026, Jan-Jun = 2027). The 2026-27 reading is confirmed by the page update dates and by matching DNREC releases. The November general firearm dates (Nov. 13-22) match DNREC's Nov. 5, 2026 news release. CWD Management Zone (Wildlife Management Zones 11, 14 and 16) has mandatory check during the November firearms season (per that release).

bagLimit: One turkey per year; bearded turkeys only
sourceTitle: Wild Turkey Hunting (DNREC Division of Fish and Wildlife)
sourceQuote: The 2027 spring wild turkey hunting season will run from April 10 through May 9, 2027. A special two-day hunt for youth and non-ambulatory hunters is set for April 3 and 5, 2027. | The bag limit is one turkey per year. Bearded turkeys only.
notes: The special youth and non-ambulatory hunt is not listed here because two DNREC sources disagree on its dates: DNREC's turkey page prints 'April 3 and 5, 2027', while the DNREC guide on eRegulations says 'Saturday April 3rd and Sunday April 4th'. Check with DNREC before that hunt. Public-land hunting is by preseason lottery for week-long segments; private land is open every day of the season.
